1.explanation: We define a Grommet theme override on radioButton.check.background.color. We then render a RadioButtonGroup with three options. Due to the bug, all three buttons pick up the blue background, rather than only the one matching the current `value`. This minimal example reproduces the issue in Chrome on Mac (Grommet v2). You can toggle the selected option and observe that the unchecked radios remain blue instead of reverting to grey.
1.bug_scenario: In this screenshot, all three radio buttons (one unchecked, one checked, one in another state) are rendered with the blue background color defined in the theme. Only the radio button that is actually checked should receive the blue background; the others should remain with the default grey/white styling.
